#
# Software Name : towards5gs-helm
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2021 Orange
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# This software is distributed under the Apache License 2.0,
# the text of which is available at todo

# Software description: An open-source project providing Helm charts to deploy 5G components (Core + RAN) on top of Kubernetes
#
# Default values for free5gc-chart.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

global:
  name: free5gc
  # Selects the SMF and UPF topology; no chart files need to be copied.
  userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl  # supported values: "single" and "ulcl"
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16  # UE IP address pool
  nrf:
    service:
      name: nrf-nnrf
      type: ClusterIP
      port: "8000"
      nodePort: "30800"
  sbi:
    scheme: http
  
  # AMF Multus CNI Configuration
  amf:
    multus:
      enabled: false  # Default: disabled for cloud-native deployments
      n2if:  # NGAP interface (used when multus.enabled=true)
        ipAddress: 10.100.50.249
      n2network:
        enabled: true
        name: n2network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.248
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.254
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.254
    service:
      ngap:
        enabled: true  # Enable NGAP service for external access
        name: amf-n2
        port: 38412
        # Used only with NodePort or LoadBalancer; set 0 for automatic allocation.
        nodeport: 31412
        protocol: SCTP
        type: ClusterIP
  
  # SMF Multus CNI Configuration
  smf:
    multus:
      enabled: false  # Default: disabled for cloud-native deployments
      n4if:  # PFCP interface (used when multus.enabled=true)
        ipAddress: 10.100.50.244
      n4network:
        enabled: true
        name: n4network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.240
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.246
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.246
  
  # UPF Multus CNI Configuration
  upf:
    multus:
      enabled: false  # Default: disabled for cloud-native deployments
      # Static IP configurations for UPF instances (used when multus.enabled=true)
      upf:
        n3if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.233
        n4if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.241
        n6if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.100.11
      psaupf1:
        n4if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.242
        n6if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.100.12
        n9if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.225
      psaupf2:
        n4if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.243
        n6if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.100.13
        n9if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.226
      iupf1:
        n3if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.234
        n4if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.245
        n6if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.100.14
        n9if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.227
      n3network:
        enabled: true
        name: n3network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.232
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.238
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.238
      n4network:
        enabled: true
        name: n4network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.240
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.246
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.246
      n6network:
        enabled: true
        name: n6network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth1
        subnetIP: 10.100.100.0
        cidr: 24
        gatewayIP: 10.100.100.1
        excludeIP: 10.100.100.254
      n9network:
        enabled: true
        name: n9network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.224
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.230
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.230


# These parameters can be used to enable/disable deployment of subcharts
deployMongoDb: true
deployAmf: true
deployAusf: true
deployBsf: true
deployChf: true
deployN3iwf: false
deployNef: true
deployNrf: true
deployNssf: true
deployPcf: true
deploySmf: true
deployScp: true
deployUdm: true
deployUdr: true
deployUpf: true
deployWebui: true
deployDbPython: false

# Disable the deployment of mongodb as an NRF subchart
free5gc-nrf:
  db:
    enabled: false

# This section can be used to override the default values in the MongoDB chart
mongodb:
  fullnameOverride: "mongodb"
  useStatefulSet: true
  auth:
    enabled: false
  persistence:
    size: 6Gi
    mountPath: /bitnami/mongodb/data/db/
  service:
    name: mongodb
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 27017
    nodePort: "30017"

# free5GC-helm

[![Helm charts linting](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/helm-charts-testing.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/helm-charts-testing.yml)
[![CNTi essential](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/raw/badges/cnti-badge.svg)](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/cnti.yml)

***free5gc-helm*** is an open-source project implemented to provide helm charts in order to deploy on one click a 5G system (RAN+SA 5G core) on top of Kubernetes. It currently relies on free5GC for the core network and free-ran-ue or UERANSIM to simulate Radio Access Network.

## Documentation
The documentation is available on the [free5GC official site](https://free5gc.org/guide/7-free5gc-helm/).

## Motivations
Please consult this [link](/motivations.md) to see the motivations that have led to this project.

## Contributing
Moving towards a Cloud native model for the 5G system is not a simple task. We welcome all new [contributions](./CONTRIBUTING.md) making this project better!

## Acknowledgement
Thanks to both Free5GC and UERANSIM teams for their great efforts.

## License
***free5gc-helm*** is under [Apache 2.0](./LICENSE) license.

## Citation
Text format:
```
A. Khichane, I. Fajjari, N. Aitsaadi and M. Gueroui, "Cloud Native 5G: an Efficient Orchestration of Cloud Native 5G System," NOMS 2022-2022 IEEE/IFIP Network Operations and Management Symposium, Budapest, Hungary, 2022, pp. 1-9, doi: 10.1109/NOMS54207.2022.9789856.
```

# free5GC-helm

[![Helm charts linting](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/helm-charts-testing.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/helm-charts-testing.yml)
[![CNTi essential](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/raw/badges/cnti-badge.svg)](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/cnti.yml)

***free5gc-helm*** is an open-source project implemented to provide helm charts in order to deploy on one click a 5G system (RAN+SA 5G core) on top of Kubernetes. It currently relies on free5GC for the core network and free-ran-ue or UERANSIM to simulate Radio Access Network.

## Documentation
The documentation is available on the [free5GC official site](https://free5gc.org/guide/7-free5gc-helm/).

## Motivations
Please consult this [link](/motivations.md) to see the motivations that have led to this project.

## Contributing
Moving towards a Cloud native model for the 5G system is not a simple task. We welcome all new [contributions](./CONTRIBUTING.md) making this project better!

## Acknowledgement
Thanks to both Free5GC and UERANSIM teams for their great efforts.

          networkInstances:
            - internet

          networkInstances:
            - internet
    AnchorUPF2:

nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

global:
  projectName: free5gc
  # Inherited from the parent chart; selects the topology helper.
  userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl  # supported values: "single" and "ulcl"
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16  # UE IP address pool
  nrf:
    service:
      name: nrf-nnrf
      type: ClusterIP
      port: "8000"
      nodePort: "30800"
  sbi:
    scheme: http
  smf:
    multus:
      enabled: false
      n4if:  # PFCP interface (used when multus.enabled=true)
        ipAddress: 10.100.50.244
      n4network:
        enabled: true
        name: n4network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.240
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.246
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.246

initcontainers:
  curl:
    registry: curlimages
    image: curl
    tag: "8.7.1"
  busybox:
    image: busybox
    tag: "1.32.0"

isPfcpNeeded: true

smf:
  name: smf
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    name: free5gc/smf
    tag: v4.3.0
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: &Port 8080
  volume:
    mount: /free5gc/config/
    tlsmount: /free5gc/config/TLS
    certmount: /free5gc/cert
  podAnnotations: {}
    # additional annotations
  imagePullSecrets: []
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsUser: 1000
    runAsGroup: 1000
    runAsNonRoot: true
    fsGroup: 1000
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
  securityContext:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
  readinessProbe:
    enabled: true
    exec:
      command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -c
        - |
          HEX_PORT=$(printf '%04X' "{{ .service.port }}")
          grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp || grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp6
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 1
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold:  40
    successThreshold: 1
  livenessProbe:
    enabled: true
    exec:
      command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -c
        - |
          HEX_PORT=$(printf '%04X' "{{ .service.port }}")
          grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp || grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp6
    initialDelaySeconds: 50
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 3
    successThreshold: 1
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
  autoscaling:
    enabled: false
    minReplicas: 1
    maxReplicas: 100
    targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
    # targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80
  ingress:
    enabled: false
    annotations: {}
      # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
      # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
    hosts:
      - host: chart-example.local
        paths: []
    tls: []
    #  - secretName: chart-example-tls
    #    hosts:
    #      - chart-example.local
  configuration:
    sbi:
      tls:
        verify: false # Verify outgoing SBI HTTPS certificates
    serviceNameList: |-
        - nsmf-pdusession
        - nsmf-event-exposure
        - nsmf-oam
    urrConfiguration: |-
      urrPeriod: 10 # default usage report period in seconds
      urrThreshold: 1000 # default usage report threshold in bytes
      requestedUnit: 1000
    # Metrics configuration
    metrics:
      enable: false # (Optional, default false)
      scheme: http # (Required) the protocol for metrics (http or https, default https)
      port: 9091 # (Optional, default 9091) port used to bind the service
      namespace: free5gc # (Optional, default free5gc)

    logger: # log output setting
      enable: true # true or false
      level: trace # how detailed to output, value: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal, panic
      reportCaller: false # enable the caller report or not, value: true or false

projectName: ueransim

initcontainers:
  sctp_test:
    image: towards5gs/sctp_test
    tag: latest

gnb:
  enabled: true
  name: gnb
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    name: free5gc/ueransim
    tag: v4.0.1
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  configmap:
    name: gnb-configmap
  volume:
    name: gnb-volume
    mount: /ueransim/config
  service:
    name: gnb-service
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 4997
    protocol: UDP

  n2if:  # NGAP
    ipAddress: 10.100.50.250
  n3if:  # GTP-U
    ipAddress: 10.100.50.236

  amf:
    n2if:  # NGAP
      ipAddress: 10.100.50.249
      serviceName: free5gc-amf-amf-n2
      port: 38412
    service:
      ngap:
        enabled: false

  podAnnotations: {}
  imagePullSecrets: []
  podSecurityContext: {}
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}

  configuration: |-
    mcc: '208' # Mobile Country Code value
    mnc: '93'  # Mobile Network Code value (2 or 3 digits)
    nci: '0x000000010'  # NR Cell Identity (36-bit)
    idLength: 32        # NR gNB ID length in bits [22...32]
    tac: 1     # Tracking Area Code
    slices:
      - sst: 0x1
        sd: 0x010203
    ignoreStreamIds: true
ue:
  enabled: true
  name: ue
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    name: free5gc/ueransim
    tag: v4.0.1
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  configmap:
    name: ue-configmap
  volume:
    name: ue-volume
    mount: /ueransim/config
  command: "./nr-ue -c ./config/ue-config.yaml"  # This is the command that will be launched in the UE container
  script: ""

  podAnnotations: {}
  imagePullSecrets: []
  podSecurityContext: {}
  securityContext:
    capabilities:
            add: ["NET_ADMIN"]
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}

  configuration: |-
    supi: "imsi-208930000000001"  # IMSI number
    mcc: "208" # Mobile Country Code value
    mnc: "93" # Mobile Network Code value (2 or 3 digits)
    key: "8baf473f2f8fd09487cccbd7097c6862" # Operator code (OP or OPC) of the UE
    op: "8e27b6af0e692e750f32667a3b14605d" # This value specifies the OP type and it can be either 'OP' or 'OPC'
    opType: "OPC" # This value specifies the OP type and it can be either 'OP' or 'OPC'
    amf: "8000" # Authentication Management Field (AMF) value
    imei: "356938035643803" # IMEI number of the device
    imeiSv: "4370816125816151"
    uacAic:
      mps: false
      mcs: false
    uacAcc:
      normalClass: 0
      class11: false
      class12: false
      class13: false
      class14: false
      class15: false
    sessions:
      - type: "IPv4"
        apn: "internet"
        slice:
          sst: 0x01
          sd: 0x010203
    configured-nssai:
      - sst: 0x01
        sd: 0x010203
    default-nssai:
      - sst: 1
        sd: 1
    integrity:
      IA1: true
      IA2: true
      IA3: true
    ciphering:
      EA1: true
      EA2: true
      EA3: true
    integrityMaxRate:
      uplink: "full"
      downlink: "full"

  test:
    connectivity:
      name: ue-connectivity-test
      image: bitnami/kubectl:1.22.0
      configmap:
        name: connectivity-test-configmap
      volume:
        name: connectivity-test-volume
        mount: /scripts
      ttlseconds: 50

cat > ~/deploy/free5gc-values.yaml <<'EOF'
# free5GC v4.3.0 (free5gc-helm @07139fc), ULCL topology, cloud-native (no Multus)
global:
  userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16

deployN3iwf: false

free5gc-upf:
  # I-UPF (BranchingUPF): N3 from gNB, N9 to both PSA-UPFs
  iupf1:
    resources: {requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi}, limits: {cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi}}
  # psaupf1 = AnchorUPF1 = Internet PSA-UPF (default path)
  psaupf1:
    resources: {requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi}, limits: {cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi}}
    configuration:
      dnnList:
        - dnn: internet
          cidr: 10.60.0.0/16   # downlink route to whole UE pool
  # psaupf2 = AnchorUPF2 = MEC PSA-UPF (specificPath for 10.43.200.10/32)
  psaupf2:
    resources: {requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi}, limits: {cpu: "1", memory: 1Gi}}
    configuration:
      dnnList:
        - dnn: internet
          cidr: 10.60.0.0/16   # downlink route to whole UE pool
EOF
cd ~/deploy && helm template free5gc-helm charts/free5gc -n free5gc -f free5gc-values.yaml > /tmp/render.yaml && grep -c '^kind:' /tmp/render.yaml && grep -E '^kind:' /tmp/render.yaml | sort | uniq -c; grep -n 'image:' /tmp/render.yaml | sort -k2 | uniq -f1 -c | awk '{print $1,$3,$4}' | sort -u -k2

 package context

@@ -54,6 +55,17 @@ func (bpMGR *BPManager) SelectPSA2(smContext *SMContext) {
 		if dataPath.Activated {
 			bpMGR.ActivatedPaths = append(bpMGR.ActivatedPaths, dataPath)
 		} else if !hasSelectPSA2 {
+			// Find the last node of the data path
+			lastNode := dataPath.FirstDPNode
+			for lastNode.Next() != nil {
+				lastNode = lastNode.Next()
+			}
+			ifaceN3 := lastNode.UPF.GetInterface(models.UpInterfaceType_N3, smContext.Dnn)
+			ifaceN9 := lastNode.UPF.GetInterface(models.UpInterfaceType_N9, smContext.Dnn)
+			if ifaceN3 == nil || ifaceN9 == nil {
+				smContext.Log.Tracef("Skipping path via UPF [%v] (DNN mismatch)", lastNode.UPF.NodeID)
+				continue
+			}

diff --git a/internal/context/bp_manager.go b/internal/context/bp_manager.go
index bc2570e..f1233dd 100644
--- a/internal/context/bp_manager.go
+++ b/internal/context/bp_manager.go
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 package context
 
 import (
+	"github.com/free5gc/openapi/models"
 	"reflect"
 )
 
@@ -54,6 +55,17 @@ func (bpMGR *BPManager) SelectPSA2(smContext *SMContext) {
 		if dataPath.Activated {
 			bpMGR.ActivatedPaths = append(bpMGR.ActivatedPaths, dataPath)
 		} else if !hasSelectPSA2 {
+			// Find the last node of the data path
+			lastNode := dataPath.FirstDPNode
+			for lastNode.Next() != nil {
+				lastNode = lastNode.Next()
+			}
+			ifaceN3 := lastNode.UPF.GetInterface(models.UpInterfaceType_N3, smContext.Dnn)
+			ifaceN9 := lastNode.UPF.GetInterface(models.UpInterfaceType_N9, smContext.Dnn)
+			if ifaceN3 == nil || ifaceN9 == nil {
+				smContext.Log.Tracef("Skipping path via UPF [%v] (DNN mismatch)", lastNode.UPF.NodeID)
+				continue
+			}
 			bpMGR.ActivatingPath = dataPath
 			hasSelectPSA2 = true
 		}

userplaneInformation: # list of userplane information
    upNodes: # information of userplane node (AN or UPF)
      gNB1: # the name of the node
        type: AN # the type of the node (AN or UPF)
        nodeID: gnb.free5gc.org # the Node ID of this gNB
      I-UPF: # the name of the node
        type: UPF # the type of the node (AN or UPF)
        nodeID: i-upf.free5gc.org # the Node ID of this UPF
        sNssaiUpfInfos: # S-NSSAI information list for this UPF
          - sNssai: # S-NSSAI (Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information)
              sst: 1 # Slice/Service Type (uinteger, range: 0~255)
              sd: 010203 # Slice Differentiator (3 bytes hex string, range: 000000~FFFFFF)
            dnnUpfInfoList: # DNN information list for this S-NSSAI
              - dnn: internet
                dnaiList:
                  - mec
        interfaces: # Interface list for this UPF
          - interfaceType: N3 # the type of the interface (N3 or N9)
            endpoints: # the IP address of this N3/N9 interface on this UPF
              - i-upf.free5gc.org
            networkInstances: # Data Network Name (DNN)
              - internet
          - interfaceType: N9 # the type of the interface (N3 or N9)
            endpoints: # the IP address of this N3/N9 interface on this UPF
              - i-upf.free5gc.org
            networkInstances: # Data Network Name (DNN)
              - internet
      PSA-UPF: # the name of the node
        type: UPF # the type of the node (AN or UPF)
        nodeID: psa-upf.free5gc.org # the Node ID of this UPF
        sNssaiUpfInfos: # S-NSSAI information list for this UPF
          - sNssai: # S-NSSAI (Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information)
              sst: 1 # Slice/Service Type (uinteger, range: 0~255)
              sd: 010203 # Slice Differentiator (3 bytes hex string, range: 000000~FFFFFF)
            dnnUpfInfoList: # DNN information list for this S-NSSAI
              - dnn: internet
                pools:
                  - cidr: 10.60.0.0/16
        interfaces: # Interface list for this UPF
          - interfaceType: N9 # the type of the interface (N3 or N9)
            endpoints: # the IP address of this N3/N9 interface on this UPF
              - psa-upf.free5gc.org
            networkInstances: # Data Network Name (DNN)
              - internet
    links: # the topology graph of userplane, A and B represent the two nodes of each link

input.command:
cat > ~/deploy/tools/restart-userplane.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Restart order matters: SMF resolves the UPF pod IPs (headless services) only at start-up,
# so UPFs first, then SMF, then gNB and UE (UE re-registers and re-establishes the PDU session).
set -e
NS=free5gc
kubectl rollout restart -n $NS deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-iupf1 deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-psaupf1 deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-psaupf2
for d in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do kubectl rollout status -n $NS deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-$d --timeout=180s; done
kubectl rollout restart -n $NS deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-smf-smf
kubectl rollout status -n $NS deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-smf-smf --timeout=180s
kubectl rollout restart -n $NS deploy/ueransim-gnb
kubectl rollout status -n $NS deploy/ueransim-gnb --timeout=180s
kubectl scale -n $NS deploy/ueransim-ue --replicas=0
kubectl wait -n $NS --for=delete pod -l app=ueransim,component=ue --timeout=120s || true
kubectl scale -n $NS deploy/ueransim-ue --replicas=1
kubectl rollout status -n $NS deploy/ueransim-ue --timeout=180s
EOF
chmod +x ~/deploy/tools/restart-userplane.sh
cd ~/deploy && helm upgrade free5gc-helm charts/free5gc -n free5gc -f free5gc-values.yaml | grep -E 'STATUS|REVISION'; ~/deploy/tools/restart-userplane.sh 2>&1 | grep -v Waiting; sleep 12; kubectl get pods -n free5gc -o wide | grep -E 'upf|smf|ueransim'; kubectl logs -n free5gc deploy/ueransim-ue | tail -3

cat > ~/deploy/tools/verify-paths.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Capture on eth0 of every UPF pod (inside its network namespace, from the host) while the UE
# sends Internet (ping 8.8.8.8) and MEC (HTTP GET http://10.43.200.10/) traffic through uesimtun0,
# then report which UPF carried which flow.
set -u
NS=free5gc; OUT=${OUT:-/tmp/upf-capture}; rm -rf $OUT; mkdir -p $OUT
declare -A IP
for u in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do
  pod=$(kubectl get pod -n $NS -l nf=$u -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
  IP[$u]=$(kubectl get pod -n $NS $pod -o jsonpath='{.status.podIP}')
  cid=$(sudo k3s crictl ps --name "^$u\$" -q | head -1)
  pid=$(sudo k3s crictl inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' $cid)
  sudo nsenter -t $pid -n timeout 25 tcpdump -i any -nn -U -w $OUT/$u.pcap 'udp port 2152 or icmp or tcp port 80' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
done
GNB=$(kubectl get pod -n $NS -l component=gnb -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}')
UE=$(kubectl get pod -n $NS -l app=ueransim,component=ue -o name)
UEIP=$(kubectl exec -n $NS $UE -- ip -4 -o addr show uesimtun0 | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1)
echo "gNB=$GNB  I-UPF(iupf1)=${IP[iupf1]}  Internet-PSA(psaupf1)=${IP[psaupf1]}  MEC-PSA(psaupf2)=${IP[psaupf2]}  UE=$UEIP"
sleep 3
kubectl cp ~/deploy/tools/httpget.pl $NS/${UE#pod/}:/tmp/httpget.pl
echo "--- UE: ping -I uesimtun0 8.8.8.8"
kubectl exec -n $NS $UE -- ping -c 5 -I uesimtun0 8.8.8.8 | tail -2
echo "--- UE: HTTP GET http://10.43.200.10/ (source $UEIP -> uesimtun0) x3"
for i in 1 2 3; do kubectl exec -n $NS $UE -- perl /tmp/httpget.pl $UEIP 10.43.200.10 80 / | grep -E '^HTTP|^Name|^RemoteAddr' | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
wait
echo; echo "=== Packet counts per UPF (eth0/any, 25s capture) ==="
printf "%-8s %-28s %-28s %-28s %-28s\n" UPF "GTP-U ICMP 8.8.8.8" "GTP-U TCP 10.43.200.10:80" "plain ICMP 8.8.8.8 (N6)" "plain TCP 10.43.200.10:80 (N6)"
for u in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do
  r(){ sudo tcpdump -nn -r $OUT/$u.pcap "$1" 2>/dev/null | wc -l; }
  printf "%-8s %-28s %-28s %-28s %-28s\n" $u \
    "$(r 'udp port 2152 and udp[20+16:4]=0x08080808 or udp port 2152 and udp[20+12:4]=0x08080808')" \
    "$(r 'udp port 2152 and udp[20+16:4]=0x0a2bc80a or udp port 2152 and udp[20+12:4]=0x0a2bc80a')" \
    "$(r 'not udp port 2152 and icmp and host 8.8.8.8')" \
    "$(r 'not udp port 2152 and tcp port 80 and host 10.43.200.10')"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Summarise a pcap (tcpdump -i any => LINUX_SLL2, or SLL/Ethernet) into flows.
GTP-U packets (UDP 2152) are decapsulated (handles E/S/PN flags + extension header chain)
so each line shows: outer src -> outer dst [TEID] | inner proto src -> dst."""
import struct, sys, collections, socket

def ip(b): return socket.inet_ntoa(b)

def l3(pkt, linktype):
    if linktype == 276: return pkt[20:]      # LINUX_SLL2
    if linktype == 113: return pkt[16:]      # LINUX_SLL
    if linktype == 1:   return pkt[14:]      # Ethernet
    if linktype in (101, 12): return pkt     # raw IP
    return None

def inner_desc(p):
    if len(p) < 20 or p[0] >> 4 != 4: return "non-IPv4"
    ihl = (p[0] & 15) * 4; proto = p[9]; s, d = ip(p[12:16]), ip(p[16:20]); l4 = p[ihl:]
    if proto == 1: return f"ICMP {s} -> {d}"
    if proto == 6 and len(l4) >= 4:
        sp, dp = struct.unpack("!HH", l4[:4]); return f"TCP {s}:{'*' if sp > 1024 else sp} -> {d}:{'*' if dp > 1024 else dp}"
    if proto == 17: return f"UDP {s} -> {d}"
    return f"proto{proto} {s} -> {d}"

def main(path):
    f = open(path, "rb"); gh = f.read(24)
    endian = "<" if gh[:4] == b"\xd4\xc3\xb2\xa1" else ">"
    linktype = struct.unpack(endian + "I", gh[20:24])[0]
    flows = collections.Counter()
    while True:
        h = f.read(16)
        if len(h) < 16: break
        _, _, incl, _ = struct.unpack(endian + "IIII", h); pkt = f.read(incl)
        p = l3(pkt, linktype)
        if not p or p[0] >> 4 != 4: continue
        ihl = (p[0] & 15) * 4
        if p[9] == 17 and len(p) >= ihl + 8 and 2152 in struct.unpack("!HH", p[ihl:ihl + 4]):
            g = p[ihl + 8:]
            flags, mtype, _, teid = struct.unpack("!BBHI", g[:8])
            if mtype != 0xff: continue                       # not a G-PDU
            off = 8
            if flags & 0x07:
                nxt = g[11]; off = 12
                while nxt:
                    ln = g[off] * 4; nxt = g[off + ln - 1]; off += ln
            flows[f"GTP-U {ip(p[12:16])} -> {ip(p[16:20])} TEID=0x{teid:x} | {inner_desc(g[off:])}"] += 1
        else:
            flows[f"plain  {inner_desc(p)}"] += 1
    for k, v in sorted(flows.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0])): print(f"{v:5d}  {k}")

main(sys.argv[1])
EOF

cat > ~/deploy/README.md <<'EOF'
# free5GC v4.3.0 + UERANSIM, ULCL with a dedicated MEC PSA-UPF (K3s, namespace free5gc)

Chart source: https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm @ 07139fcc6f7579928a0722e274bdc876a4a4e240
(pristine clone in ~/src/free5gc-helm; working copy in ./charts with the local patch
./free5gc-helm-07139fc-local.patch applied — SMF ULCL template only).

Install:
  kubectl create ns free5gc
  helm install free5gc-helm charts/free5gc  -n free5gc -f free5gc-values.yaml
  # add subscriber imsi-208930000000001 via WebUI API (POST /api/subscriber/imsi-208930000000001/20893, body subscriber.json)
  helm install ueransim     charts/ueransim -n free5gc -f ueransim-values.yaml

User plane (SMF names):  gNB1 -N3-> BranchingUPF (iupf1) -N9-> AnchorUPF1 (psaupf1, Internet, default path)
                                                          \-N9-> AnchorUPF2 (psaupf2, MEC, specificPath 10.43.200.10/32)

Local chart patch (charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/templates/_smf-ulcl.tpl):
  1. `ulcl: true` — without it SMF v4.3.0 ignores uerouting.yaml entirely (no ULCL at all).
  2. AnchorUPF2 also declares an N3 interface — SMF v4.3.0 BPManager.SelectPSA2 skips any
     specificPath PSA lacking N3+N9 for the DNN ("No more valid PSA2 path found").
  3. UE1 specificPath dest 1.0.0.1/32 -> 10.43.200.10/32 (the MEC app).
Values: PSA dnnList cidr widened to 10.60.0.0/16 (downlink route for whole UE pool on both PSAs);
mongodb uses K3s local-path instead of the chart's microk8s PV; UPF CPU requests lowered.

Operational note: SMF resolves the UPF pod IPs only at start-up. If any UPF pod is recreated,
run tools/restart-userplane.sh (UPFs -> SMF -> gNB -> UE).

Verification: tools/verify-paths.sh (captures in each UPF netns, decodes GTP-U with tools/gtp_flows.py).
EOF
cat > /home/vagrant/.claude/projects/-home-vagrant-work/memory/free5gc-ulcl-k3s.md <<'EOF'

name: free5gc-ulcl-k3s

**Why:** the upstream ULCL template is broken for SMF v4.3.0: missing `ulcl: true`, and specificPath PSA must declare both N3 and N9 (SelectPSA2 check), else MEC traffic silently stays on the default PSA.

EOF

content.text:
部署完成，兩項要求都達成。UE 已註冊並建立 PDU session，介面是 `uesimtun0`，IP 10.60.0.2。經由這個 tunnel，ping 8.8.8.8 成功，`http://10.43.200.10/` 也回 200。封包擷取顯示 MEC 流量只經過 MEC 專用的 PSA-UPF，上網流量只經過另一個 PSA-UPF。`mec` namespace 沒有改動。

要注意的是，指定 commit 的 chart 原樣部署時 **ULCL 不會生效**。我第一次部署時 MEC 連得到，但 MEC 回報的來源 IP 是上網用 PSA-UPF 的 pod IP，代表流量根本沒分流。這是 chart 範本和 SMF v4.3.0 不相容造成的，我在本機 chart 副本裡修了 SMF 範本才解決（見下面第 1 部分）。

## 1. 部署的元件與設定

全部放在 namespace `free5gc`。
- **free5GC v4.3.0**（helm release `free5gc-helm`）：AMF、AUSF、BSF、CHF、NEF、NRF、NSSF、PCF、SCP、SMF、UDM、UDR、WebUI、MongoDB。所有映像都是 `v4.3.0`。不用 Multus，各元件直接用 pod IP（chart 預設的 cloud-native 模式）。
- **3 個 UPF**（gtp5g 轉送）：

  | Pod | 在 SMF 裡的名稱 | 角色 |
  |---|---|---|
  | `iupf1` | BranchingUPF | I-UPF／ULCL：N3 接 gNB，N9 接兩個 PSA |
  | `psaupf1` | AnchorUPF1 | 上網用的 PSA-UPF（預設路徑），對外 NAT |
  | `psaupf2` | AnchorUPF2 | MEC 專用的 PSA-UPF，只處理 `10.43.200.10/32` |
- **UERANSIM**（helm release `ueransim`）：1 個 gNB、1 個 UE。
- **網路參數**：PLMN 208/93；slice SST 1、SD 010203；DNN `internet`；UE 位址池 10.60.0.0/16。
- **訂閱者** `imsi-208930000000001`：透過 WebUI API 新增，內容在 `subscriber.json`，格式照 WebUI v1.4.6（free5GC v4.3.0 用的版本）的原始碼。

**Chart**：用的是 commit `07139fcc…`。原始 clone 在 `~/src/free5gc-helm`，沒有動過。下面三處修改都在 `~/deploy/charts` 這份副本的 SMF ULCL 範本裡，完整差異在 `free5gc-helm-07139fc-local.patch`：
1. **加上 `ulcl: true`。** 少了這一行，SMF 會完全不讀分流設定檔 `uerouting.yaml`，所有流量都走預設路徑。
2. **讓 AnchorUPF2 同時宣告 N3 介面。** SMF v4.3.0 選第二個 PSA（`SelectPSA2`）時，只接受同時有 N3 和 N9 介面的 UPF；這是上游 2025-12 的修改（commit 0a5d00f）。不加的話，MEC 路徑會被默默跳過，日誌只寫 "No more valid PSA2 path found"。
3. **把 UE1 的分流目的地從 `1.0.0.1/32` 改成 `10.43.200.10/32`**，路徑為 BranchingUPF → AnchorUPF2。

**values 檔**（不需要改 chart 就能設定的部分）：

## 2. 我怎麼確認網路是正確的

**控制面**
- SMF 和 3 個 UPF 都完成 PFCP association。
- UE 的日誌依序出現 Registration accept、PDU Session Establishment Accept、`uesimtun0` 建立。
- SMF 日誌依序出現 `Has pre-config ULCL paths`、`Establish PSA2`、`EstablishULCL`，表示分流確實有建起來。
- 每個 UPF 目前只剩一個 PFCP session：重啟前留下的舊 session 已被刪除。

**使用者面**：`~/deploy/tools/verify-paths.sh` 會從主機進入每個 UPF pod 的網路空間擷取封包，同時讓 UE 經 tunnel 送 5 個 ping 到 8.8.8.8、3 次 HTTP GET 到 MEC。GTP-U 封包再由 `gtp_flows.py` 拆開，看出隧道裡面裝的是哪一種流量。結果如下：

| UPF | 看到的流量 |
|---|---|
| iupf1 (.49) | 只有 GTP-U 封包，沒有任何解封裝後送出去的流量。ICMP 8.8.8.8 走 .49→**.50**（5 包），TCP 10.43.200.10:80 走 .49→**.51**（15 包）；回程對應 |
| psaupf1 (.50) | 只有 ICMP 8.8.8.8，解封裝後 NAT 出去；沒有任何往 MEC 的封包 |
| psaupf2 (.51) | 只有 TCP 10.43.200.10:80，解封裝後送往 MEC；沒有任何 ICMP 8.8.8.8 |

**應用層也能獨立佐證**：MEC 應用（whoami）回報的 `RemoteAddr` 是 `10.42.0.51`，也就是 psaupf2 的 pod IP。修正前這裡顯示的是 psaupf1 的 `10.42.0.27`，也就是一開始那個問題被抓到的地方。

## 其他注意事項
- **UPF pod 重建後要重啟一輪。** SMF 只在啟動時解析一次 UPF 的 pod IP，所以任何 UPF pod 被重建後，都要執行 `~/deploy/tools/restart-userplane.sh`。它會依序重啟 UPF → SMF → gNB → UE。
- **MEC 測試沒用 curl。** UE 映像裡沒有 curl，而 Debian 鏡像站不同步，`apt-get` 裝不起來。我改用映像內建的 perl 寫了 `tools/httpget.pl`，綁定 UE 的 tunnel IP 發送請求。UERANSIM 有一條「從 UE IP 出發就查 `rt_uesimtun0` 路由表」的規則，所以這個請求一定經過 5G tunnel。
